items.text: Kosodi akaulo katular kotema EJAKAIT Musa ka Eleasar okoku loka Aaron esasedoti, atiar,
“Kimar etiai loka ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kere luepedorete alosit ojie koIsirael.”
Kinerata Musa ka Eleasar esasedoti kakes kapuuton naka Moab kariri naka Yorodan ko Yeriko, ebe,
“Kimarata etiai loka ituŋa, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito”; kwape kieorakinia EJAKAIT Musa ka idwe luka Isirael luanyounete kakwap nako Misiri.
Reuben, ekiyai loka Isirael: odwe luka Reuben: Kanok, ekek loka Ikanokin: Palu, ekek loka Ipaluin:
Kesuron, ekek loka Ikesuronin: Karami, ekek loka Ikaramin,
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Ireubenin: ŋul Iuaponi kimarai kakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka luuni, ka akwat akanykaarei ka akaisauni.
Odwe luka Eliab; Nemuel, ka Datan, ka Abiram. Ŋupenul kes Datan ka Abiram, luanyaraunio kokodety luetepegete Musa ka Aaron nepepe ka Kora, naetepegeata EJAKAIT:
Koona akwap akeituk, kiliko kes nepepe ka Kora, naketwania erioŋet ŋol; kapak naanyamia akim ituŋa akwat aarei ka akaisakany, koraut aanyunet.
Konye mam odwe luka Kora anotu kotwaka.
Odwe luka Simeon kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Nemuel, ekek loka Incmuelin; Yamin, ekek loka Iyaminin; Yakin, ekek loka Iyakinin:
Sera, ekek loka Iserakin: Saul, ekek loka Isaulin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Isimeonin, ilukumin akaisaarei ka luarei, ka akwat aarei.
Odwe luka Gad kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: Sepon, ekek loka Iseponin: Kagi, ekek loka Ikagin; Suni, ekek loka Isunin:
Osuni, ekek loka Ikosunin: Eri, ekek loka Ierin:
Arod, ekek loka Irodain: Areli, ekek loka Irelain:
Ŋul kes ikekia luka odwe luka Gad kwape ajaatar ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka akwat akany.
Odwe luka Yuda, Er ka Onan: kotwakikis Er ka Onan akwap naka Kanaan,
Odwe luka Yuda kwape ajaatar ikekiakee; Sela, ekek loka Iselanin: Peres, ekek loka Iperesin: Sera, ekek loka Iserakin.
Odwe luka Peres, Kesuron, ekek loka Ikesuronin: Kamul, ekek loka Ikamulin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Yuda kwape ajaatar nul luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisakanykaarei ka lukanykape ka akwat akany.
Odwe luka Isakar kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Tola, ekek loka Itolain: Puba, ekek loka Ipubain:
Yasub, ekek loka Iyasubin: Simuron, ekek loka Isimuronin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Isakar kwape ajaatar luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisakanykape ka luonon ka akwat auni.
Odwe luka Sebulun kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: Sered, ekek loka Iseredin; Elon, ekek loka Ielonin: Yaleel, ekek loka Iyaleelin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Isebulunin kwape ajaatar nul luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisakanykape ka akwat akany.
Odwe luka Yosep kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: Manase ka Epuraim,
Odwe luka Manase: Makir, ekek loka Imakirin: kouru Makir Gilead: Gilead, ekek loka Igileadin.
Lu kes odwe luka Gilead: Ieser, ekek loka Ieserin; Kelek, ekek loka Ikelekin:
Ka Asuriel, ekek loka Isurielain: ka Sekem, ekek loka Isekemin:
Ka Semida, ekek loka Isemidain; ka Keper, ekek loka Ikeperin,
Ka Selopekad okoku loka Keper amameete idwe lusap, dimarai apesur: ikiroria luka apesur nuka Sclopekad kes Mala, ka Noa, ka Kogila, ka Milika, ka Tirusa.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Manase: ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisakany ka luarei ka akwat akanykaarei.
Lu kes odwe luka Epuraim kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: Sutela, ekek loka Isutelakin: Beker, ekek loka Ibekerin: Takan, ekek loka Itakanin,
Lu kes odwe luka Sutela: Eran, ekek loka Ieranin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka odwe luka Epuraim kwape ajaatar nul luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisauni ka luarei ka akwat akany, Ŋul kes odwe luka Yosep kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Odwe luka Benyamin kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Bela, ekek loka Ibelain; Asubel, ekek loka Isubelain: Akiram, ekek loka Ikiramain:
Sepupam, ekek loka Isupamin: Kupam, ekek loka Ikupamin,
Odwe luka Bela kes Arid ka Naaman, Arid ekek loka Iridain; Naaman, ekek loka Inaamanin,
Ŋul kes odwe luka Benyamin kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: nul luaponi kimaraikakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka lukany ka akwat akanykape.
Lu kes odwe luka Dan kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Sukam, ekek loka Isukamin. Ŋul kes ikekia luka Dan kwape ajaatar ikekiakec.
Ikekia kere luka Isukamin, kwape ajaatar nul luaponi kimarai kakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisakanykape ka luoŋon ka akwat aoŋon.
Odwe luka Aser kwape ajaatar ikekiakec: Imuna, ekek loka Imunamin: Isibi, ekek loka Isibin: Beria, ekek loka Iberian.
Odwe luka Beria: Keber, ekek loka Ikeberin: Malakiel, ekek loka Imalakielin,
Ekiror da loka akoku naka Aser ŋes Sera.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka odwe luka Aser kwape ajaatar luaponi kimarai kakesi, ilukumin akaisakany ka luuni ka akwat aoŋon.
Odwe luka Naputali kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Yakuseel, ekek loka Iyakuseelin: Guni, ekek loka Igunin:
Yeser, ekek loka Iyeserin: Silem, ekek loka Isilemin.
Ŋul kes ikekia luka Naputali kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: nul luaponi kimarai kakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka lukany ka akwat aoŋon,
Ŋul kes luaponi kimarai kodwe luka Isirael, ilukumin akwat akanykape ka lodiopet ka akwat akanykaarei ka akaisauni (601,730).
“Mama ejaas ŋul ŋes ekorakinio akwap araun airumet kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroria.
Mama ejaas luipu iinakini airumet naepol, mama ejaas luikidioko iinakini airumet naedir: mama ejai ŋinidiopet kwape ejaatar nul luaponi kimarai kaluke einakinio airumeteke.
Konye ekorokoro akwap kailamilam eroet: irumete kwape ejaatar ikiroria luka atekerin nuka Iukapapaakec,
Kwape ejaunor eroet ŋes ekorakinere airumetekec mama ejaas luipu ka luikidioko.”
Lu kes luaponi kimarai luka Ilebin kwape ajaatar ikekiakee: Gereson, ekek loka Igeresonin: Kokat, ekek loka Ikokatin: Merari, ekek loka Imerarin.
Lu kes ikekia luka Ilebin: ekek loka Ilibunin, ekek loka Ikeburonin, ekek loka Imalin, ekek loka Imusin, ekek loka Ikorakin. Kouru Kokat Amuram.
Ekiror da loka aberu naka Amuram ŋes Yokebed, akoku naka Lebi, naaurie Lebi kotoma Misiri: kourik ŋesi Amuram Aaron ka Musa ka Miriam kinacikec.
Kouri Aaron Nadab ka Abiku, ka Eleasar ka Itamar.
Kotwaka Nadab ka Abiku, naainakiniata akim naitegelikina kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.

Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi emwaasi ilukumin akaisaarei ka luuni, ŋolikiliokit ageun kayenika elap ediopet ka luedeparito: naarai mam emarakinitai toma odwe luka Isirael, naarai mam ainakinitai kes airumet kodwe luka Isirael.
Ŋul kes luemarete Musa ka Eleasar esasedoti; luemarete idwe luka Isirael kapuutona nuka Moab kariri naka Yorodan koYeriko.
Konye kotoma kanul amamei idiotuŋanan kakwi luemarete Musa ka Aaron esasedoti; luemarete idwe luka Isirael kotoma amodiŋ naka Sinai.
Naarai abu EJAKAIT kolimu nukee cbe, “Abeit etwakikinete toma amodiŋ.” Mam ediotuŋanan kakesi abu kideun, dimarai Kaleb okoku loka Yepune, ka Yosua okoku loka Nun.
